about: Housing in Irpin: new builds, townhouses and a private sector

In recent years Irpin has become one of the main commuter towns for Kyiv residents: many apartments here are bought in new complexes, often unfinished or with a developer finish that owners want to redo right away. Nearby are townhouses and cottage communities among the pines, and closer to the Irpin river an older private sector.

Since 2022 some houses have gone through restoration, and for them we start with an inspection of the structure and services: what can be kept and what is better replaced before finishing. In new builds, the first step is checking the developer's screed, walls and wiring before laying tiles and fitting furniture.

An apartment in an Irpin complex is often small and open-plan, and that is where a design project pays off fastest: a well-planned kitchen-living room, a walk-in wardrobe instead of a wasted corridor, light in every zone. For houses and townhouses we add stairs, terraces and the link with the plot. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate apartments from shell condition or with a developer finish, townhouses and houses, and also do separate [rough renovation](/en/rough-renovation). Plots in Irpin and nearby Vorzel and Stoianka are often narrow and wooded, so we design the house for the specific plot; we build from aerated block and brick, as well as [timber-frame houses](/en/timber-frame-house).

The same salaried team as in Kyiv, at the same rates: renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials), and if CAS carries out the renovation, the final total stays within ±5% of the estimate. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m²; 12-month warranty on works. More on [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Our site managers include visits to the town in their normal schedule, just as for Kyiv districts, and materials come from Kyiv warehouses. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks; an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.

faq: Do you renovate new-build flats with a developer finish?
Yes. First we assess what of the developer's work can stay (often part of the rough works) and what has to be redone, and only then draw up the estimate.
Do you take on houses that need restoration?
Yes: we start with an inspection of the structure and services, then [house reconstruction](/en/house-reconstruction) or major renovation per estimate.
How much does renovation in Irpin cost?
From $550 per m² for works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are separate, per estimate.
Who will work on the site?
Our own salaried team, covering different levels of complexity and types of work. 12-month warranty on works.
